about.name: Francisco Avila
about.title: Lead Software Engineer
about.bio: USMC Infantry Veteran and experienced software engineer with a passion for building scalable systems and applications.

bullets: Led a team of software engineers to develop scalable web applications.
Implemented CI/CD pipelines to streamline deployment processes.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to define project requirements.
Developed web applications using modern frameworks and technologies.
Participated in code reviews and contributed to team knowledge sharing.
Assisted in the design and implementation of scalable backend systems.
Trained and mentored Marines in combat tactics and operations.
Developed and implemented training programs to enhance combat readiness.
Led teams in high-pressure environments to achieve mission objectives.

education.description: Completed an intensive 15 week program focused on full stack web development, covering both frontend and backend technologies.

projects.title: Pokemon Informant
projects.description: The Pokemon Informant is a web application that provides detailed information about Pokemon by leveraging the PokeAPI to fetch and display data about various Pokemon.

projects.title: The Video Store
projects.description: The Video Store is a OOP Python terminal program that allows users to manage a video rental store, including adding, updating, and deleting video records, as well as tracking rentals and returns.

projects.title: Rick & Morty Informant
projects.description: The Rick & Morty Informant is a web application that provides detailed information about characters, episodes, and locations from the Rick & Morty TV show.

projects.title: E-Commerce API
projects.description: The E-Commerce API is a backend service that provides endpoints for managing products, orders, and users in an e-commerce application.

projects.title: School Manager API
projects.description: The School Manager API is a backend service that provides endpoints for managing students, teachers, classes, and other school-related data in a school management application.

projects.title: Personal Project
projects.description: The Personal Project is a Full-Stack application with Authentication, CRUD, and 3rd party API's.

projects.title: Agentic Coding Project
projects.description: The Agentic Coding Project is a web application that was built by completely relying on Agentic Tools like Claude Code to build a Full-Stack application with Authentication, CRUD, and 3rd party API's.

projects.title: Group Project
projects.description: The Group Project is a Full-Stack application with Authentication, CRUD, and 3rd party API's built through collaboration with a 5-10 person team that I participated in.
